scope: Same people/features/folds. TUG raw seconds LGBM/TabICLv2/TabPFNv2; weighted raw seconds LGBM. Frailty original models threshold-only, plus inverse-frequency weighted multiclass LGBM.
tug_weight: fixed2 if12<=y<20,4 ify>=20,else1; select weighted model by inner weighted MAE,raw model by inner MAE
threshold: P(frail)>=threshold; smallest threshold satisfying pooled inner OOF nonfrail FPR<=0.10(primary) or0.20(secondary). No external labels. Also report original argmax and P(frail)>=0.5.
selection: LGBM same16grid/inner3splits. Weighted frailty choose mean per-class logloss. Foundation fixed8ensembles. No new probability calibration. Original LGBM selected inner predictions reused for threshold. Foundation inner3 new fits on outertrain only.
metrics: TUG paired MAE,bias,slow>=20 n9,12..20,under12; stratified frailty rates,ROC-AUC,AP,recall,FPR,PPV and confusion; paired bootstrap10000 conditional fixed OOF. Compare speed/features and same-input new/original. Report actual held-out FPR; target not guaranteed. Exploratory reused development cohort.
verification: Hash source/checkpoints, train/test IDs, inner partitions, independently reconstruct threshold and selection, save/reload new LGBM final+inner, reconstruct all new foundation final+inner from contexts; atol/rtol1e-6; independent outcome metrics.
